renders.name: Precision — professional
renders.prompt:
Create a premium photorealistic packaging design exploration, ONE individual image, ONE full 500 g resealable stand-up pouch, entire pouch visible, front-facing with very slight three-dimensional right gusset showing, generous neutral warm grey studio backdrop and soft ground shadow. Portrait composition 1024x1536. Same pack geometry and camera framing as reference. Reference 1 establishes TRAYN brand wordmark, product identity and pack proportions ONLY; radically redesign its printed graphics according to the direction below. 
DIRECTION: Restrained premium professional design. Warm ivory matte pouch, black TRAYN logotype, precisely typeset charcoal typography, a narrow deep oxblood vertical band along left edge, small silver foil geometric line detail. Confident editorial negative space with a large sophisticated WHEY word, no clinical symbols. This must look like a meticulous premium sports nutrition brand, not generic black packaging.
Required exact visible front-label text, typeset legibly with appropriate hierarchy: "TRAYN", "NUTRITION", "WHEY", "WPC + WPI Blend", "Whey Protein Concentrate +", "Whey Protein Isolate", "Belgian Chocolate", "Net Quantity: 500 g", "Contains Milk". Include a small but clearly readable bottom label band "PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE".
No other text. No TM or registered symbols, no FSSAI marks or licences, no nutritional figures, no fake certification, no ingredient claims, no health claims, no barcode, no numbers other than 500 g. No food props or photorealistic ingredient images. This is a sophisticated design agency presentation of a conceptual package for adult sports nutrition. Photorealistic printed material and lighting. Do not put direction name or commentary on background.
